lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular clusters are visible posterior to the pectoral fin, arranged in vertical columns. The first column contains four primary nodes, followed by subsequent columns forming a grid-like distribution across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity connect the circular blobs, creating a structured rectangular grid pattern where the blobs serve as nodes at the intersections.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a light-to-shadow vertical gradient. The primary ridge originates above the pectoral fin and extends posteriorly toward the caudal region.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin surface displays a dense arrangement of smaller, lower-intensity spots that contrast with the larger, higher-intensity blobs on the primary flank.
